title: 주말 계획 말하기: 집에서 쉴까 봐요
objective: By the end, you can build the -(으)ㄹ까 봐요 form from any action verb and use it to say what you are thinking of doing, such as "I think I might go to bed early."
summary: Learn to use -(으)ㄹ까 봐요 to talk about a plan you are thinking about but have not decided yet.

task.title: Use -(으)ㄹ까 봐요
task.line: Make the right form, check whether each sentence is correct, and finish the dialogue and sentences with -(으)ㄹ까 봐요.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a vowel (자다, 쉬다, 보다).
forms.means: I think I might ~ / I'm thinking of ~ (not decided yet).
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm tired today, so I think I might go to bed early.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a consonant (먹다, 읽다, 입다).
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm thinking of having kimchi stew for lunch.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in ㄹ (만들다, 놀다, 살다). Do not add 을.
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm thinking of making gimbap with a friend this weekend.

forms.when: Irregular verbs like 걷다 and 묻다 change ㄷ to ㄹ.
forms.exampleMeaning: The weather is nice, so I might walk home.

watchOut: 만들을까 봐요 (X) → 만들까 봐요 (O): If the stem ends in ㄹ, just add -까 봐요.
친구는 내일 쉴까 봐요. (X) → 저는 내일 쉴까 봐요. (O): Use it for your own plan, not for someone else's.
내일 꼭 갈까 봐요. (X) → 내일 꼭 갈 거예요. (O): If you have already decided, use -(으)ㄹ 거예요, not -(으)ㄹ까 봐요.
할까봐요 (X) → 할까 봐요 (O): Put a space before 봐요.
exercises: Write the -(으)ㄹ까 봐요 form: ① 배우다 ② 놓다 ③ 열다 ④ 듣다
Mark each sentence O (correct) or X (wrong): ① 저는 저녁에 운동을 할까 봐요. ② 동생은 내일 도서관에 갈까 봐요. ③ 오늘은 지하철을 탈까 봐요. ④ 다음 주에 부산에 놀러 갈을까 봐요.
Fill in the blank with -(으)ㄹ까 봐요 (자르다): 머리가 너무 길어요. 이번 주말에 미용실에서 머리를 ____.
Complete B's answer with -(으)ㄹ까 봐요 (가다): A: 이번 휴가에 뭐 할 거예요? B: 아직 잘 모르겠어요. 제주도에 ____.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 봐요 / 사진을 / 공원에서 / 찍을까
answers: ① 배울까 봐요 ② 놓을까 봐요 ③ 열까 봐요 ④ 들을까 봐요
① O ② X ③ O ④ X (갈까 봐요)
공원에서 사진을 찍을까 봐요. (사진을 공원에서 찍을까 봐요.)
